levels.surface: أبي جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه

notes: Two sayings in one report (rule 11): the report's own narrative of Aswad, with Ruhi as the source of the Imam's prayer; and Ibn Babawayh's «قال أبو جعفر بن بابويه: وكان ... يقول لي» with its own isnad, which is not written as a group here.
«أخيه» is an epithet of Husayn b. Ali (his brother), not a separate link. «[1/250] غيبة الطوسي:» is a title.
«علي بن الحسن» asked Aswad to ask Ruhi; he is in the scene, not a link. The Imam is named only as the addressee («مولانا صاحب الزمان») and acts through Ruhi's report, so he is not written as a link.
